people.name: Auri
people.firstMeet: At her house in Falkreath (Auri's House).

day.where: in and around Auri's House, Falkreath
day.doing: going about her home; her sandbox package sits above her midnight-to-8 am sleep package and has no hours, so the records give her no separate bedtime

changes: Both of her home packages only run while she isn't your follower; once she follows you she goes where you go.

quests.how: gives it: she's homesick, and you take her to beautiful places (Moss Mother Cavern, Eldergleam Sanctuary, Ancestor Glade, Bloated Man's Grotto and more)

unsure.why: She is set up as a potential follower, but the dialogue that recruits her (and any condition on it) isn't in the extracts.
She has a vendor entry (same buy list as Belethor's General Goods, open all hours) but no merchant chest and no merchant faction, so it may only be follower trading; not confirmed.
Only a class record id and an outfit id are in the extracts; neither resolves to a name, skills or a weapon here, so I can't say how they fight.
She fills aliases in six more of her own quests that have no name in the extracts.
She has her own lines in Discerning the Transmundane before its blood-gathering steps are done; the records don't say what they do.
